name: What materials are available for roof replacement?

mainEntity.name: What materials are available for roof replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common roofing materials include asphalt shingles, metal roofing, and tile. Asphalt shingles are popular for their affordability and variety. Metal roofs offer durability and energy efficiency, while tile provides a distinctive aesthetic and long lifespan. Your choice will depend on your budget, desired aesthetic, and climate considerations.
